method: Informed solo touch on the production preview, native game clock. Starts with the first intentional input in each sitting. Closed-tab gaps excluded. Categories assigned at the recorded transitions.

rows.intention: First-time. I want to take Fig home and see what the Bakery gives the road.
Fig joined at the left edge. I moved across the wall to the x3 preview showing 63 instead of 41.
Town discovery. Share the first bun is beside Fig. I want to find who gets it before taking my three starters to Sleepy Signs.
First-time. Picked Clover. I want the three sign painters because Town had empty signs.
Chosen mastery. I moved left after the striped gate and got the multiplier. I want to replay and hold left earlier for the painters.
Menu search. No replay in the report. Going back through the Tambo offer to find the map.
Chosen mastery. Replaying L2 with the newly offered Tambo. Stay left at striped gate even if it costs the multiplier.
First payoff. Three sign painters came through; result remembers last time x3. 248 versus 58. Tambo called sleepers across the road while I kept my line. Next I want to see the flags on Treat Street.
First-time Treat Street. The painters stood at the drum prompt. At the hedge my left read 154 under the 160 wall. I tried another swipe after the fork closed and arrived with just 66.
Correction: 66 was an intermediate animation count. The actual clear was 1713, with Tambo and the painter trading the last beat.
First-time. Seedfall first. Want to catch a falling friend, then take the hoods if a letter turns up.
Town discovery. Four of eight, 36 friends shy of three stars. There is no letter before Drizzle Dell is cleared. Looking at the two lamps and Blossom.
Town discovery. Spending 180 on Tambo because I expect to improve Seedfall. Want to see if there is a drummer in the band.
First-time. Taking the right-hand next road button to get the yellow hoods. Tambo is at the stand now.
First-time. The balloon and multiplier took me to the right. The riders got the cart. My late left swipe did not escort the yellow hoods. Next I want to wake Mumu, then come back for the picnic.
Natural stop after Mumu. Next I want to take the yellow coats to the two lamps, then find what the first lantern lights. Closing now; I will check which invitation I recognise when I reopen.
Town discovery. On returning Mumu is floating by the band and there is an envelope on the fountain. Following my yellow-coat plan via that envelope.
Chosen mastery. Holding hard left this time, including the last shower. Leaving the balloon for the next parade.
Town discovery. The trio made it. The result invitation clipped the last words beyond the right edge of the phone; the main Visit the picnic label was readable. Following it now.

Natural stop. Three hoods are sitting beside the lamps and pears. The live return plan paid off. I want to meet the cat next. End this pilot to fix the visibly clipped result receipt before taking the release candidate further.
